notes.title: Upcoming Game Update Info + Patch Notes 1.0.10
notes.content:
Hi there,

Just wanted to let all you know if I will update game further and the short answer is that at least one update is in the works!

It will be small update (so don't expect anything big) adding a bit more content as a thank you to you all for the support! Time to Strike isn't a massive success, but I'm very happy how launch went, so as a thank you I will be adding few more items that got cut from full release!

As of future update I'm not sure. I might from time to time add new weapons, relics, mods but no promises!

And also I updated game a bit, so that means Patch Notes!

[list]
[*] Timer is now paused while there are no enemies
[*] A bit more currency will be given after run, so you could unlock more exiting weapons, trinkets sooner
[*] Added information that any deflected bullet is affected by bat mods to Book of Forgotten Knowledge
[/list]


Thanks for the support and have a great day,
Ravernt

notes.title: Updated demo version is out!
notes.content:
Hi,

I'm exited to announce that new demo version is out! I put a lot of effort to polish it as much as possible, so I hope you will enjoy it! This should be the final version of the demo, so next milestone will be full release!

Demo changes:
[list]
[*]Game graphics were massively updated (at least in my opinion :) )
[*]Elite enemies! Tougher enemy variations that sometimes spawn during waves
[*]Boss relics! Unique relics that are obtained after boss fight (there are 4 in the demo, but I am planning to add at least 26 more for full release)
[*]Some starting weapons/trinkets were changed
[*]A lot of weapon/relic/mod reworks and balance changes
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]

As always, every bit of feedback is appreciated, so if you find a bug, think that something should change or have a great suggestion, feel free to let me know.

Thanks for reading and have a great day,
Ravernt
